worldcombat.skill.workup.summary: Rouses itself to raise Attack and Sp. Atk together. The lower its health, the hotter the fire: the stronger of the two gains an extra stage, and it is short enough to slip between attacks.
worldcombat.skill.workup.use.0: Open a fight with a quick rouse
worldcombat.skill.workup.use.1: Turn being pressured into more resolve
worldcombat.skill.workup.use.2: Top up both offences between attacks
worldcombat.skill.workup.description.0: Rouse: Attack +%1$s stages and Sp. Atk +%2$s stages; below the injury threshold the stronger side gains one more.
worldcombat.skill.workup.description.2: Telegraph %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.workup.timing: The telegraph can be interrupted without paying anything; PP and cooldown settle only after commit.
worldcombat.skill.workup.preference.desp: On: the extra stage triggers below 65% health, but the telegraph is 3 ticks longer and the cooldown 12 longer. Off: it needs below 40%, but the move is quicker and comes back sooner.
worldcombat.skill.workup.preference.ai.m: Consider rousing when a threat is within this distance; larger commits earlier and risks being caught while settling.
worldcombat.skill.workup.preference.ai.e: Below this health fraction the companion rouses ahead of the shared order; raise it to seize the moment more often, lower it to stay calm.
world_combat.move.workup.text.backfoot: Backs to the wall (Attack +%1$s / Sp. Atk +%2$s)
